description.value: Chicken Box is a locally grown BC fast-food chain focused on fried chicken and burgers, with three locations across Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley. The North Vancouver outpost on 2nd Street East is compact and quick-service, making it a practical calorie stop for cyclists passing through the Lower Lonsdale area. Online ordering is available for both pickup options.
